validation.native_build: success; VitaSDK 2026.08; VPK structure and Title ID checks passed
validation.quality: success; catalog import, browser logic, native local-library/profile/UI host tests

hardware_acceptance.note: Earlier 00.05 baseline was user-confirmed on a PS Vita 1000; that does not validate the 00.10 magazine redesign or this exact VPK.
required: Install and launch this exact VPK on PS Vita 1000 and 2000 where available
Verify title identity and existing-data preservation
Check magazine layout, typography, focus, D-pad and touchscreen behavior
Check suspend/resume, offline startup, corrupt/missing local data recovery and shutdown
Record model, firmware, exact VPK SHA-256 and observed results

limitations: Native app still uses versioned app-owned local files; the versioned SQLite schema and host migration harness are not yet integrated into Vita runtime.
Automatic playtime tracking is not implemented.
Community accounts, votes and cloud sync require a future backend.
release_decision: Do not tag or publish a stable release until the exact 00.10 VPK passes the physical-device acceptance checklist.
